top_signals.title: Stocks Slide After Hot Inflation Boosts December Rate Hike Bets
top_signals.summary: US equities are lower after hotter-than-expected inflation data released on Tuesday bolstered the case for an interest rate hike by the Federal Reserve in December.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Post Office and Accenture set date to end 25-year Fujitsu contract
top_signals.summary: The Post Office has agreed to end a contract it has held with Fujitsu for over 25 years and hand over operations to Accenture by next year.
